mapper.insert: INSERT INTO categories (name, description, display_order, is_active) VALUES (#{name}, #{description}, #{displayOrder}, #{isActive}) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name, description = EXCLUDED.description, display_order = EXCLUDED.display_order, is_active = EXCLUDED.is_active
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, description, display_order, is_active FROM categories ORDER BY display_order ASC, id ASC
SELECT id, name, description, display_order, is_active FROM categories WHERE is_active = true ORDER BY display_order ASC, id ASC
